subject.title: [Feature]: WebUI notification system, cron job management popups, and context monitor integration

question: Should OpenClaw add a shared connected-Control-UI notification/action queue for cron results and context pressure, and how should cron snooze/reschedule actions be represented?
rationale: The remaining work is valid but crosses UI architecture, cron scheduling semantics, context UX, Web Push settings, WebChat actions, and admin notification security boundaries.

options.title: Design Shared UI Notifications First
options.body: Define one Control UI notification/action contract, then implement cron-result popups and context-pressure actions on top of it.

options.title: Fold Into WebChat Actions
options.body: Make chat, cron, and notification actions share the broader WebChat inline button/callback model before adding new popup UI.

options.title: Defer In-App Popups
options.body: Keep current support limited to cron history, inline context usage, and Web Push settings until maintainers choose a notification roadmap.

recommendation.title: Design Shared UI Notifications First
recommendation.body: Define one Control UI notification/action contract, then implement cron-result popups and context-pressure actions on top of it.

likelyOwner.reason: He has the strongest current product-routing signal from the prior issue review and adjacent cron notification history.
